building_details.building_ref: 170 High Street N/A shopfront and grilles only

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: n/a this application for shopfront and grilles only

description: Installation of a new shop front and the installation of two extraction grilles to rear side elevation of the existing premises
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Cover Letter dated 18 June 2021, 20-106, 21-106-Hounslow-01-Location and Site Plan, 21-106-Hounslow-02-Existing and Proposed Floor Plan, 21-106-Hounslow-03-Exisitng Proposed Shop Front, 21-106-Hounslow-04-Exisitng Rear and Side Elevation, 21-106-Hounslow-05-Proposed Extraction, Technical Details Air Clean Carbon Filter, Technical Details Air Supply fan unit 102 H2WL4, Technical Details AV Mounts,  Fan Rescue Technical Extraction Statement, Odour Control Assessment, Technical Details CP03-C-Series-1 3, Technical Details ESP 5000B UV ozone,  Technical Details ESP RYB SERIES, Technical Details G4 Prefilter 3, Technical Details Helios GBW5604 2, Technical Details HEPA Filters, R02-Rectanguar-Silencers-1 4 Received: 18 June 2021)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Mechanical Services Noise Control

a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system etc operates. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or 1 meter from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved. 

b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter. 

c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review.

Condition : 4 - The glazed frontage hereby approved shall be clearly defined with visual manifestations on the glass at two levels: between 850mm to 1000mm and 1400mm to 1600mm above ground level. The manifestations shall be fixed to, painted on or etched into the glass in the form of a continuous or broken (by no more than 20 mm) horizontal band 50 mm high, or a series of signs or logos at least 150 mm high spaced no further than 300 mm apart.  The manifestations shall contrast visually with their surroundings when viewed from both inside and outside the building in all lighting conditions.
The door shall either be of an automatic opening type or shall have a 400 millimetre high steel kick plate attached across the full width at the base, and the door edges shall be designed in such a manner that they are clearly identifiable for a person with impaired vision from the adjoining shop windows when closed, by means of colour contrast at eye level. A door handle shall be installed either vertically or diagonally on the door at a height between 0.90 metre and 1.20 metre from the floor, contrasting in colour and luminance with the surface of the door in a material that is warm to the touch.
The door shall open inwards only and shall have a threshold that is level with the adjoining footway and the internal floor, or shall be designed to have a gradient between the two not exceeding 1:12 that does not impede the passage of a wheelchair.

Condition : 5 - No waste generated as a result of the new kitchen facility facilitated by this approved development shall be stored outside the site and waste shall only be stored in lidded bins that shall be fixed shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.  Waste shall be removed from the site to a suitable enclosed private storage area or an authorised refuse disposal or recycling site as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.
